pairs: And you will say in that day:
because you have been angry with me;
but your fury has been turned away,
and I will not be afraid.
For the Lord is my strength and my praise,
et factus est mihi in salutem.
and he has become my salvation.”
Haurietis aquas in gaudio de fontibus salvatoris.
You will draw water with gladness from the fountains of the Savior.
And you will say in that day:
notas facite in populis adinventiones ejus;
Make his plans known among the peoples!
mementote quoniam excelsum est nomen ejus.
Remember that his name is exalted!
Announce it to the whole world!
quia magnus in medio tui Sanctus Israël.
For the Great One, the Holy One of Israel, is in your midst!”
